title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agents usage report
summary: The report description, licensing distinction and both governance controls are supported by Microsoft documentation. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting GCC documentation, complete the report navigation and reconcile the checklist with the controls table.

claims.quote: A new agents usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The report is reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Reports > Usage > Microsoft Copilot > Agents.

claims.fix: Use 'Microsoft 365 admin center > Reports > Usage > Reports > Microsoft Copilot > Agents' in the rollout checklist, retaining the Reports heading that the What's changing prose already gives.

claims.quote: The sum of active users without a license and active users with a license might exceed the total active users if you assigned or removed licenses during the selected timeframe.

claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/reportSettings updates the tenant-level report setting.
claims.quote: Update tenant-level settings for Microsoft 365 reports. ... PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/reportSettings

claims.quote: displayConcealedNames | Boolean | If set to true, all reports conceal user information such as usernames, groups, and sites. If false, all reports show identifiable information.

claims.claim: The report-settings Graph call is beta and unsupported in production applications.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The tenant-wide concealing setting governs user identification in the Agents report.
claims.quote: By default, the usage report anonymizes the username and display name. Global administrators can change settings to reveal or conceal these values.
